concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Desegnos logo concept presentation, standalone mark plus full wordmark.
Context: Desegnos is a desktop visual website editor where users point at a canvas and describe what belongs there.
Composition: clean white concept sheet, large standalone capital D in the upper half; beneath, the full name "Desegnos" in one horizontal wordmark. The EXACT SAME custom D shape must be the first letter of the wordmark, proportionally scaled to the remaining letters. Do not place a separate icon beside a wordmark with another D. Generous whitespace, crisp flat vector-like forms.
Text verbatim: "Desegnos" (D-e-s-e-g-n-o-s). Only that word; no titles, captions, slogans or other text.
Constraints: distinctive readable capital D, strong silhouette, works as an app icon at small sizes, balanced negative space, matching typography, monochrome black on white for form evaluation, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no stationery mockups, no watermark.
Direction: precise geometric design. A bold custom D constructed from a straight upright and a beautifully balanced rounded bowl with one restrained purposeful cut suggesting an open creative canvas. Clean contemporary geometric sans serif remaining letters, optical spacing. Simple and confident, not a generic stock D.
